subject.title: feat: auto-detect provider usage and billing stats

question: Should OpenClaw make provider usage discovery and structured billing a public core/plugin API plus Usage dashboard feature now, and what provider-reported billing schema should be canonical?
rationale: The source gap is reproducible, but the change affects plugin API semantics, provider billing interpretation, dashboard UX, and compatibility with existing `summary`/`plan` consumers; the protected `maintainer` label also requires human direction.

options.title: Define additive usage contract
options.body: Keep this open and specify plugin-discovered providers, structured billing fields, existing summary compatibility, provider coverage, and dashboard behavior before implementation.

options.title: Split provider-specific coverage
options.body: Track individual OpenRouter, Venice, DashScope, Copilot, and other provider hooks separately while deferring the shared billing schema.

options.title: Keep current usage surfaces
options.body: Leave provider usage in CLI/status/model-auth surfaces for now and revisit dashboard billing after a maintainer-sponsored design.

recommendation.title: Define additive usage contract
recommendation.body: Keep this open and specify plugin-discovered providers, structured billing fields, existing summary compatibility, provider coverage, and dashboard behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the issue and recent provider usage work, making him the strongest available owner for schema, provider coverage, and dashboard scope.
